issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Resurf
products.tagline: A Personal Context Library for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 个人上下文库
products.descriptionZh: Resurf 是一款个人上下文应用，用于记录你喜欢、关心和正在处理的事情。保存笔记、链接、图片、PDF 和想法。之后可以随时找到它们，或通过 MCP 和 CLI 将这些上下文交给 AI。原生支持 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad，本地存储并支持私密 iCloud 同步。
products.description: Resurf is a personal context app for things you like, care about, and work on. Save notes, links, images, PDFs, and ideas. Find them later or hand that context to AI through MCP and CLI. Native on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, with local storage and private iCloud sync.

products.name: Perplexity Hybrid Compute
products.tagline: Splitting AI tasks: Cloud for research, Mac for privacy
products.summaryZh: 拆分AI任务：云端用于研究，Mac用于隐私保护
products.descriptionZh: 混合计算现已上线 Perplexity Computer，即其 Mac 应用。它会在云端和你自己的 Mac 之间拆分任务：研究和推理在云端由他们最强的 AI 完成，而任何涉及你私人文件的操作都留在你的 Mac 上由本地 AI 处理，因此这些文件永远不会被上传。适用于 Apple 芯片，最低 24GB 内存，现已面向 Pro/Max/Enterprise 开放。
products.description: Hybrid Compute is now live on Perplexity Computer, their Mac app. It splits a task between the cloud and your own Mac: research and reasoning happen in the cloud with their strongest AI, while anything touching your private files stays on your Mac with a local AI, so it never gets uploaded. Works on Apple silicon, 24GB RAM minimum, live now for Pro/Max/Enterprise.

products.name: Cognition's SWE-2
products.tagline: Cognition's coding model, 64% cheaper than Fable 5.1
products.summaryZh: Cognition的编程模型，比Fable 5.1便宜64%。
products.descriptionZh: SWE-2 是 Cognition 的新编码模型，基于 Kimi K3 通过强化学习后训练而成，同时优化成本与能力。它在 FrontierCode 1.1 Main 上达到 50.0%，与 Fable 5.1 相差不到一个百分点，成本却低 64%；与 GPT-6 Astra 相差几个百分点，成本仅为其四分之一。相比 SWE-1.7，它所需轮次减少 58%，成本降低 81%，得分反而更高。现已在 Devin Desktop 和 CLI 中提供。
products.description: SWE-2 is Cognition's new coding model, post-trained from Kimi K3 with RL that optimizes for cost and capability at the same time. It hits 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within a point of Fable 5.1 at 64% less, and lands within a few points of GPT-6 Astra at a quarter of the cost. Compared to SWE-1.7 it takes 58% fewer turns and costs 81% less while scoring higher. Available now in Devin Desktop and CLI.

products.name: ScreenCursor
products.tagline: Screen recorder with auto zoom effects
products.summaryZh: 带自动缩放效果的屏幕录制工具
products.descriptionZh: 录制屏幕后，直接获得已应用镜头运动的成品视频。每一次点击、拖拽和按键都会自动变成缩放效果。无需编辑，所有内容都不会离开你的电脑。
products.description: Record your screen and get back a finished video with the camera moves already in place. Every click, drag and keystroke becomes a zoom. No editing, and nothing ever leaves your computer.

products.name: Visiby
products.tagline: Track and grow your visibility across AI search
products.summaryZh: 跟踪并提升你在AI搜索中的可见度
products.descriptionZh: Visiby 帮助品牌衡量、理解并提升其在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews 等 AI 搜索平台上的可见度。追踪品牌提及、推荐和引用，发现竞争对手的领先之处，并识别在 AI 生成回答中提升自身存在感的机会。
products.description: Visiby helps brands measure, understand, and improve their visibility across AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Track brand mentions, recommendations, and citations, discover where competitors are winning, and identify opportunities to improve your presence in AI-generated answers.

products.name: Clipwise
products.tagline: Save any page to Notion
products.summaryZh: 将任意页面保存到 Notion
products.descriptionZh: Clipwise 可将任意网页保存到你的 Notion 数据库——保存整篇文章，而非一半。无需账户、无需登录、无付费墙。保存前填写数据库属性，它会记住你上次的选择。所有内容都保留在你的电脑上。
products.description: Clipwise saves any web page to your Notion databases — the whole article, not half of it. No account, no login, no paywall. Fill in your database properties before saving, and it remembers your last one. Everything stays on your computer.

products.name: DemoTV
products.tagline: The audience-ranked TV channel for product demos
products.summaryZh: 面向产品演示的观众排名电视频道
products.descriptionZh: DemoTV是一个全天候播放产品演示的频道，由观众排名决定顺序。免费提交简短演示。观众观看一对一的频道对决，支持他们真正愿意尝试的产品，而Elo风格的观众评分决定谁占据1至3频道。企业可以购买明确标注的播出时间：金钱买得到曝光、完整观看和点击，但绝买不到排名。
products.description: DemoTV is a 24/7 channel of product demos, ranked by the people watching. Submit a short demo for free. Viewers watch head-to-head Channel Battles and back the product they'd actually try, and an Elo-style audience score decides who sits on Channels 1-3. Businesses can buy clearly labelled airtime: money buys exposure, completed views and clicks, never the ranking.

products.name: SHIUI
products.tagline: Hinomaru Ink Web UI Kit in Japanese Hinomaru style
products.summaryZh: 日之丸风格日文版Hinomaru Ink Web UI套件
products.descriptionZh: SHIUI — 一款扁平墨韵 UI 套件，秉承日之丸日本海报的精神。纸、墨、朱红。零阴影。
products.description: SHIUI — a flat ink UI kit in the spirit of Hinomaru Japanese posters. Paper, sumi, vermilion. Zero shadows.

products.name: GhostWriter by MyHandler
products.tagline: Two taps and it's already written
products.summaryZh: 轻点两下，即刻成文
products.descriptionZh: 别的AI你让它写什么它就写什么。Ghostwriter写的是你早已知道的内容。在任何应用、任何文本框中双击左Ctrl，回复即刻出现——取自屏幕上的对话、你的日历、你的文件和过往会议，全部索引在电脑上的加密保险库中。它不会把你的日程排重，还会根据你与对方的沟通方式调整措辞，连落款都一致。然后它就停住：只输入到框里，绝不发送。Windows。
products.description: Every other AI writes what you tell it. Ghostwriter writes what you already know. Double-tap Left Ctrl in any text field, in any app, and the reply is there — drawn from the thread on screen, your calendar, your files and your past meetings, indexed in an encrypted vault on your PC. It won't double-book you, and it matches how you write to that person, down to the sign-off. Then it stops: it types into the box and never sends. Windows.

products.name: Epilude Notetaker
products.tagline: 100% private meeting notes
products.summaryZh: 100%私密的会议记录
products.descriptionZh: Epilude 在你的 Mac 上录制会议，无需机器人加入通话，随后生成转录文本、摘要和行动项。笔记以 Markdown 文件保存，归你所有。
products.description: Epilude records meetings on your Mac with no bot in the call, then writes the transcript, summary, and action items. Notes save as Markdown files you own.

products.name: Neopress
products.tagline: Build and grow your website by chatting with AI
products.summaryZh: 通过与AI聊天来构建和发展你的网站
products.descriptionZh: 在一个由 AI 驱动的循环中构建并发展你的网站。Neopress 将网站创建、CMS、SEO 和分析整合到一个工作空间。发布服务端渲染、AI 可读的页面，让搜索引擎和 AI 爬虫都能访问。然后让 AI 分析你的指标，发现洞察，并将其转化为对网站和内容的改进。构建、发布、衡量、学习、改进，全程通过对话完成。
products.description: Build and grow your website in one AI-powered loop. Neopress brings website creation, CMS, SEO, and analytics into a single workspace. Publish server-rendered, AI-readable pages that search engines and AI crawlers can access. Then ask AI to analyze your metrics, uncover insights, and turn them into improvements to your site and content. Build, publish, measure, learn, and improve, all through conversation.

products.name: Best Productivity Resources
products.tagline: Directory of best tools, apps, guides, and other resources
products.summaryZh: 最佳工具、应用、指南及其他资源的目录
products.descriptionZh: 一个精心挑选的生产力工具、应用、AI 工具、课程、书籍和资源目录。每条收录都直接链接到真实产品网站，并在收录前经过审核。用它来寻找经过筛选的任务管理、专注、笔记、自动化等选项。
products.description: A hand-curated directory of productivity tools, apps, AI tools, courses, books, and resources. Every listing links directly to the real product website and is reviewed before inclusion. Use it to find vetted options for task management, focus, note-taking, automation, and more

products.name: Naverny Borshchu
products.tagline: Find and rate best borshch on one map
products.summaryZh: 在一张地图上找到并评价最好的罗宋汤
products.descriptionZh: 一张乌克兰红菜汤的社区地图。31座城市的278碗汤，每碗都由真正吃过的人按7项标准打分：肉感、甜菜味、浓稠度、咸度、余味、卖相、总体。其中103碗已有评分，另外175碗尚无评分，谁先品尝其中一碗，谁就成为它的发现者并留名。免费、开源、无广告、无推广链接。
products.description: A community map of Ukrainian borshch. 278 bowls across 31 cities, each scored on 7 criteria by people who actually ate them: meatiness, beetiness, thickness, saltiness, aftertaste, presentation, overall. 103 are already rated, the other 175 still have no score and whoever tastes one first stays on it as its discoverer. Free, opensourced, no ads and no affiliate links

products.name: TablePro
products.tagline: Native database client, free and open source
products.summaryZh: 原生数据库客户端，免费且开源
products.descriptionZh: TablePro 可连接 35 种数据库，涵盖 MySQL、Postgres 到 MongoDB、Redis 和 DuckDB。采用 AppKit 和 SwiftUI 编写，无 Electron，无 JVM。冷启动不到一秒，空闲内存占用 80 MB。编辑器、表格、导入和导出功能免费。AGPL v3 许可。
products.description: TablePro connects to 35 databases, from MySQL and Postgres to MongoDB, Redis and DuckDB. Written in AppKit and SwiftUI, no Electron, no JVM. Cold start under a second, 80 MB idle. Editor, grid, import and export are free. AGPL v3.

products.name: Cue
products.tagline: The Awwwards-tier UI component library.
products.summaryZh: Awwwards级别的UI组件库。
products.descriptionZh: 隆重推出 CUE —— 面向现代 Web 的 Awwwards 级 UI 组件库。探索不断丰富的精美交互组件集合，助你打造不仅好用、更能脱颖而出的网站。从大胆的 hero 区块到流畅的交互、独特的布局与用心的微动画，CUE 将高端 Web 设计带到你的下一个项目身边。少些构建，多些创造。探索 CUE → cuedesign.space
products.description: Introducing CUE — the Awwwards-tier UI component library for the modern web. Explore a growing collection of beautifully crafted, interactive components designed to help you build websites that don’t just work — they stand out. From bold hero sections to smooth interactions, unique layouts, and thoughtful micro-animations, CUE brings high-end web design closer to your next project. Build less. Create more. Explore CUE → cuedesign.space

products.name: Gemini app for Windows
products.tagline: Alt + Space and Gemini is right there
products.summaryZh: 按下 Alt + 空格，Gemini 就在眼前
products.descriptionZh: 适用于 Windows 10 和 11 的官方 Gemini 桌面应用。按 Alt + Space 即可在当前工作界面之上即时唤起 Gemini，用于起草文本、通过 Gemini Spark 运行代理任务，并直接跨 Gmail、Docs 和 Google Drive 获取上下文。
products.description: The official Gemini desktop app for Windows 10 and 11. Summon Gemini instantly over active work with Alt + Space to draft text, run agentic tasks with Gemini Spark, and pull context directly across Gmail, Docs, and Google Drive.

products.name: Arazio
products.tagline: Convert any file without leaving Finder
products.summaryZh: 在访达中即可转换任何文件
products.descriptionZh: 每个转换器都要你打开它、导入文件、选择格式，再找到输出文件。Arazio 把这四步全部省去。在 Finder 中选中文件，按住 Shift，光标周围便会出现一个径向菜单，只显示该文件实际能转换成的格式。朝某个格式松开，转换后的文件就会出现在原文件旁边。283 种转换，43 种格式，14 个工具。一切都在你的 Mac 上运行——转换引擎完全不含网络代码，并由一项会使构建失败的测试强制执行。
products.description: Every converter makes you open it, import the file, pick a format and find the output. Arazio removes all four steps. Pick a file up in Finder, hold Shift, and a radial menu appears around your cursor showing only the formats that file can actually become. Release toward one and the converted file lands next to the original. 283 conversions, 43 formats, 14 tools. Everything runs on your Mac — the conversion engines contain no networking code at all, enforced by a test that fails the build.

products.name: MonoDuty
products.tagline: On-call alerts that reach you by email, SMS, and phone
products.summaryZh: 通过电子邮件、短信和电话接收值班警报
products.descriptionZh: MonoDuty 将事件告警、值班排班、正常运行时间监控和 cron 心跳整合在一起，面向小型工程团队。通过 webhook 连接你的工具，将告警路由给正确的人，并通过电子邮件、短信和语音通话对未响应的事件进行升级。借助 Slack、Discord 和 Microsoft Teams 更新让团队随时了解情况。免费开始；付费方案增加短信、语音和升级策略。
products.description: MonoDuty brings incident alerts, on-call schedules, uptime monitors, and cron heartbeats together for small engineering teams. Connect your tools through webhooks, route alerts to the right person, and escalate unanswered incidents with email, SMS, and voice calls. Keep the team informed with Slack, Discord, and Microsoft Teams updates. Start free; paid plans add SMS, voice, and escalation policies.

products.name: Baroque  2.0
products.tagline: AI design with the entire internet as its reference.
products.summaryZh: 以整个互联网为参考的AI设计。
products.descriptionZh: Baroque v2 生成最美观的网页和应用设计，速度前所未有。一个网页代理从互联网各处抓取实时设计参考，数百条设计法则确保每个界面保持一致。导出可直接用于生产的 React 代码或 Figma。零 AI 垃圾。
products.description: Baroque v2 generates the best-looking web and app designs, faster than ever. A web agent pulls live design reference from across the internet, and hundreds of design laws keep every screen consistent. Export production-ready React code or Figma. Zero AI slop

products.name: Kirokune
products.tagline: Keep work incident notes on your iPhone, without an account
products.summaryZh: 在iPhone上记录工作事件笔记，无需账户
products.descriptionZh: 在iPhone时间线中保存工作事件笔记、录音和照片。无需账户。单个案件中的记录数量不限，免费使用；额外案件和PDF导出为可选付费功能。包含免费的事件日志模板。
products.description: Keep work incident notes, recordings and photos in an iPhone timeline. No account needed. Unlimited records in one case are free; extra cases and PDF export are optional paid features. Includes a free incident-log template.
